Title:Finetuned Language Models Are Zero-Shot Learners
View PDF
Abstract:This paper explores a simple method for improving the zero-shot learning abilities of language models. We show that instruction tuning -- finetuning language models on a collection of tasks described via instructions -- substantially improves zero-shot performance on unseen tasks.
